messages:
emma: FYI customer reported daily usage chart/export mismatch. Org timezone is Asia/Kolkata but CSV rows are splitting at 00:00 UTC. They say totals don't match the dashboard.
ryan: Which customer? can you drop org_id + example CSV?
emma: org: org_8e2c. Attaching minimal CSV rows (redacted) they sent: 
```
date,tokens,org_id
2026-03-01 18:30:00+00,1200,org_8e2c
2026-03-01 22:45:00+00,800,org_8e2c
2026-03-02 01:15:00+00,500,org_8e2c
```
Customer expects the two 3/1 rows to be in 2026-03-02 in Asia/Kolkata (UTC+5:30) so totals are split.
akiko: Thanks. Quick hypothesis: exports/tiles pipeline is doing daily bucketing in UTC for CSVs even when org has custom tz. Dashboard UI might render per-org tz, so numbers differ.
lee: Where is tz applied? is it at ingestion or during aggregation?
akiko: I looked at the code — analytics service groups by date_trunc('day', event_ts) (no AT TIME ZONE). So server default (UTC) used. We should use date_trunc('day', (event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE org_tz) or equivalent.
ryan: Can we reproduce? steps?
emma: Repro on staging: export for org_8e2c with org_tz=Asia/Kolkata. I ran query against staging raw_events and grouped by date_trunc('day', event_ts) -> 2026-03-02 rows split vs expected.
akiko: Proposed patch (SQL):
```
-- before
SELECT date_trunc('day', event_ts) AS day, sum(tokens) FROM events WHERE org_id = $1 GROUP BY 1;
-- after
SELECT date_trunc('day', (event_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE org_tz) AS day, sum(tokens)
FROM events JOIN org_settings USING (org_id) WHERE org_id = $1 GROUP BY 1;
```
lee: I'll take the change and add a feature flag so exports/backfill can pick org_tz. assigning to eng-reports.
emma: Customer-facing copy: "We're investigating — exports and daily charts may use UTC bucketing in some cases. We'll push a fix and backfill affected days."
akiko: Important edge: DST and zones with non-hour offsets (India) — test vectors: Asia/Kolkata, America/Caracas, Pacific/Chatham.
lee: I'll add unit tests and a small backfill job that recomputes daily aggregates for the last 14 days for org_8e2c and any orgs with custom tz.
emma: ETA to customer?
lee: canary build later today, full rollout tomorrow if canary looks good.
deploy-bot: canary deployed to analytics-canary at 2026-03-02T16:30:00Z (build 2026.3.2-rtz).
akiko: quick QA checklist for support: 1) export CSV row count matches dashboard totals after canary 2) timestamp shown on CSV header indicates timezone used 3) backfill job ran and updated past 14 days.
emma: noted. I'll ask customer to re-download after canary and report back.
lee: logging note: add a debug flag to exports to emit `bucket_tz: <org_tz>` to make future triage easier.
emma: thanks all — keeping this thread pinned to the ticket #SUP-4721. will update when customer confirms.
